# AturSeva Home Page — Zone-by-Zone Design Description

## Overall Feel
A clean, **airy** mobile healthcare UI on a **white (#FFFFFF)** page background. Rounded cards, soft shadows, 3D-rendered illustrations paired with flat line icons. Typography is a modern sans-serif (Roboto/Inter-like) for everything **except** the logo, which is set in a **script/handwriting font** ("Atur Seva" — cursive, connected strokes, like Pacifico or a signature style).

---

## 1. Header (top bar)
- **Left:** Location pin icon (solid black, rounded style) next to two-line location text: **"Gandhinagar," / "Gujarat"** in bold black, with a small chevron-down dropdown beside it.
- **Center:** **"Atur Seva"** in the script/handwriting font, black, large (~28–32px).
- **Right:** Bell notification icon (outline style) with a small **red dot** at top-right.
- No border/divider — header floats on white.

## 2. Hero Section
- **Left column:** 
  - Headline: **"Healthcare, made simpler."** — very large, heavy/bold, pure black, two lines.
  - Sub-copy: "Find doctors, book appointments and track your turn in real time." — regular weight, dark gray, ~16px.
- **Right:** A 3D illustration of a friendly cartoon doctor (white coat, stethoscope, arms crossed, brown hair) standing in front of a 3D hospital building with a green cross, with green bushes. Sits on a light gray blob/backdrop shape.

## 3. Search Bar
- Full-width pill (large border radius, ~full rounding or ~32px).
- **White fill with a soft drop shadow** (subtle, diffuse).
- Left: black magnifier outline icon.
- Placeholder: "Search doctors, hospitals, tests, symptoms…" — light gray text.
- Right: black **microphone** icon.
- Generous vertical padding — tall, comfortable input.

## 4. Quick Action Cards (4-up horizontal row)
- Four equal **white cards** with rounded corners (~16px) and **soft shadows**, sitting on white bg (distinguished purely by shadow).
- Each card contains:
  - A **3D icon illustration** in a circular light-gray badge: doctor bust (Doctors), hospital building (Hospitals), test tubes with red liquid (Lab Tests), laptop with avatar (Video Consult).
  - **Bold title** (black): "Doctors", "Hospitals", "Lab Tests", "Video Consult".
  - Small gray subtitle: "Clinic & Video", "OPD & Departments", "Diagnostics", "Consult from home".

## 5. Dark Token Banner
- Full-width **near-black (#1A1A1A / #222)** rounded card (~24px radius).
- **Left:** Bold white headline, two lines: **"Skip the wait. / Book your token online."**
  - Below: two inline feature chips with small white icons: ⚡ "Real-time queue" and 📅 "Confirmed slot" (white text, small size).
- **Right:** 3D graphic of stacked white token cards; the front card reads **"Token"** in script font and **"#24"** in large bold black — tilted, layered card stack with soft shadows.

## 6. "Your appointment" Section
- Section header: bold black title "Your appointment" left; right link **"View all →"** (dark gray text + arrow).
- **Appointment card** (white, large radius ~24px, soft shadow):
  - **Top row:** Circular doctor avatar photo (real photo, male, white coat) left. Name **"Dr. Adam Max"** bold; subtitle gray "Psychologist • City Care Clinic". Right: **green pill badge** (light mint green fill, ~#E6F4EA) with green dot + **"Live Queue"** in green bold text.
  - **Stats row (3 columns, divided by thin vertical gray lines):**
    - **#24** / "Your Token"
    - **#18** / "Now Serving"
    - **06** / "Patients Ahead"
    - Numbers big and bold black; labels small gray.
    - Far right: a small circular white button with **chevron-right**, slight shadow.
  - **Progress bar** at bottom: thick, fully rounded track in light gray; filled portion **solid black** (~60–65% width).

## 7. "Explore by Specialty"
- Header: bold "Explore by Specialty" + "View all →" link.
- Six square-ish **white cards** (~rounded 16px, subtle shadow) in one horizontal scrollable row:
  - Cardiology (heart with pulse line), Pulmonology (lungs), Neurology (brain), Gastro (stomach), Gynecology (uterus), More (2×2 grid of circles).
  - All icons are **thin black line/outline style**, uniform stroke weight.
  - Label below each in small bold black text.

## 8. Lab Tests Promo Banner
- Full-width rounded card with **pale mint-green background** (#EAF5EC-ish).
- **Left:** Bold black heading two lines: **"Book Lab Tests / from trusted labs"**, gray sub-line "Home collection available", then a **black pill CTA button** "Book Tests →" with white text and arrow icon.
- **Right:** 3D illustration of a microscope plus a rack of test tubes with red liquid and a green plant, blending into the mint background.

## 9. Bottom Navigation
- Floating white bar, full-width, heavily rounded top (~32px), soft shadow above.
- Four items, outline icons with labels:
  - **Home** — active: filled house icon, bold black label, inside a **light-gray pill/oval highlight** around the item.
  - **Bookings** — calendar icon.
  - **Health Records** — medical-file icon.
  - **Account** — person icon.
  - Inactive items: thin gray-black outline icons, regular-weight labels.

---

## Spacing & Rhythm
- **Airy**: generous vertical gaps (~24–32px) between sections, ~16px side margins, tall cards with roomy internal padding.
- **Consistent radius language:** pill for search/CTA, ~16px for small cards, ~24px for large cards/banners.
- **Color palette:** white + black + grays, with only three accent colors — green (Live Queue badge, mint promo, hero foliage) and red (notification dot, tube liquid). No blues or purples anywhere; monochrome-first design.
